correctness.rationale: The historical review verified the semigroup reduction, canonical residue formulas, exact Frobenius number/genus and symmetry.

originality.rationale: The historical review found no exact exponent-10 determination and recorded Zenkin 1995 as residual risk.

value.rationale: The historical review judged the exact exponent-10 semigroup/invariants valuable, but it incorrectly described Conjectures 10.1/10.2 as applying to exponent 10; that attribution is superseded by this audit.

historical_review.superseded_note: The earlier review incorrectly described exponent 10 as a case of Benfield--Lippard Conjectures 10.1/10.2. This audit corrects that attribution; the exact semigroup theorem remains valid.
